fullTextEN: Hello, I am Xika from Taiwan.
How are you?
In this series,

fullTextZH: 我们说了三个女人的故事。
fullTextEN: We talked about the stories of three women.

fullTextZH: 可是今天我要说男人的故事。
fullTextEN: But today I want to talk about men's stories.
In ancient China,
There was a special kind of man,
They were eunuchs.
Why were they special?

fullTextZH: 因为他们是没有下面的男人。
fullTextEN: Because they were men without genitals.

fullTextZH: 对，他们没有男人的生殖器。
fullTextEN: Yes, they did not have male genitals.
Maybe you have seen in movies,

fullTextZH: 太监，他们常常在皇帝的旁边。
fullTextEN: Eunuchs, they were often beside the emperor.

fullTextZH: 那为什么太监没有男人的生殖器呢？
fullTextEN: So why did eunuchs not have male genitals?

fullTextZH: 他们在皇帝旁边做什么呢？
fullTextEN: What did they do beside the emperor?

fullTextZH: 现在我告诉你一个故事，
fullTextEN: Now I will tell you a story,
Then you will know.
There was a eunuch,
His name was Sun Yaoting.
He was born in 1902.
His family is in the countryside of Tianjin.
His parents are farmers.

fullTextZH: 有一年，他的家变得很穷，
fullTextEN: One year, his family became very poor,
There was no money for food.
What to do?
His parents thought: Hmm,
Being a eunuch is a good job,
You get a salary and a place to live,
and you also have food to eat.

fullTextZH: 好，让一个儿子去当太监吧！
fullTextEN: Okay, let one son become a eunuch!
They had four sons.

fullTextZH: 为什么是孙耀庭当太监，
fullTextEN: Why was it Sun Yaoting who became a eunuch,
and not someone else?
Because to become a eunuch,
being too old is not okay,
and being too young is also not okay.
Sun Yaoting was 8 years old then,
8 years old was okay,
very suitable.

fullTextZH: 所以爸爸妈妈决定让孙耀庭去当太监。
fullTextEN: So his parents decided to let Sun Yaoting become a eunuch.
What about Sun Yao Ting himself?
Did he want to become a eunuch?
He was only 8 years old,
He was hungry every day,
So he only thought: Hmm,
Becoming a eunuch means living in the palace,
and eating good food.

fullTextZH: 而且农村里很多人去当太监，
fullTextEN: Moreover, many people in the countryside became eunuchs,
and some even got rich.
So he also thought: Hmm,
Becoming a eunuch isn't bad.

fullTextZH: 可是他没想到当太监的痛苦。
fullTextEN: But he didn't think about the pain of becoming a eunuch.
Yes, you know,

fullTextZH: 太监是没有下面的男人。
fullTextEN: A eunuch is a man without genitals.
Before becoming a eunuch,

fullTextZH: 要先割掉男人的生殖器。
fullTextEN: one must first remove the male genitals.
Removing the male genitals,
makes him unable to have children.
This is called castration.
It feels very painful!

fullTextZH: 那为什么太监要净身呢？
fullTextEN: So why do eunuchs need to be castrated?
Because they work in the palace.

fullTextZH: 皇宫有皇帝的老婆、女儿，
fullTextEN: The palace has the emperor's wives and daughters,
many women.

fullTextZH: 太监没有男人的生殖器，
fullTextEN: Eunuchs do not have male genitalia,
they will not sleep with women,
and they cannot have children.

fullTextZH: 皇帝不用担心太监的小孩来杀他、害他。
fullTextEN: The emperor does not worry about eunuchs' children killing or harming him.
So Sun Yaoting wanted to become a eunuch,

fullTextZH: 他知道他的身体会受伤，
fullTextEN: he knew his body would be injured,
but he didn't know it would be so painful.
Even more frightening is,

fullTextZH: 他们家没有钱请医生帮净身。
fullTextEN: their family had no money to hire a doctor for the castration.
So what to do?
His father took a knife and did it himself.
Do you think it's dangerous or not?
Very dangerous!
So what happened to Sun Yaoting?
Sun Yaoting was in extreme pain,
and he fainted.
He was in a coma for three days.
But he didn't die.
His body slowly recovered.
But at this time, in 1912,
The Qing Dynasty in China ended.
China no longer had an emperor.
Is there still a need for eunuchs without an emperor?
Sun Yaoting and his parents, wow,

fullTextZH: 快疯了，他们不知道怎么办。
fullTextEN: were almost going crazy, they didn't know what to do.
But later,
they heard that

fullTextZH: 皇帝和他的家人还住在北京的皇宫，
fullTextEN: the emperor and his family still lived in the Beijing palace,
which is the Forbidden City.

fullTextZH: 他们还是要太监来工作。
fullTextEN: They still needed eunuchs to work.

fullTextZH: 所以孙耀庭的爸妈赶快拜托人，
fullTextEN: So Sun Yaoting's parents quickly asked someone for help,

fullTextZH: 最后孙耀庭可以去当太监了。
fullTextEN: and finally Sun Yaoting could become a eunuch.

fullTextZH: 嗯，他的爸妈都非常高兴。
fullTextEN: Hmm, his parents were very happy.

fullTextZH: 你猜猜太监的工作是什么呢？
fullTextEN: Can you guess what a eunuch's job is?

fullTextZH: 他们的工作是照顾皇帝和他的家人。
fullTextEN: Their job was to take care of the emperor and his family.

fullTextZH: 像吃饭、洗澡、穿衣服都要太监帮忙。
fullTextEN: Things like eating, bathing, and dressing all needed eunuch's help.

fullTextZH: 那孙耀庭当太监差不多17年。
fullTextEN: Sun Yaoting was a eunuch for about 17 years.

fullTextZH: 他三十几岁的时候就不再当太监了。
fullTextEN: He stopped being a eunuch when he was in his thirties.
He didn't work as a eunuch,

fullTextZH: 可是以后他也不能结婚，
fullTextEN: but later he couldn't get married,
and couldn't have children.
Many people knew he was a eunuch,
and didn't want to talk to him.

fullTextZH: 因为以前的人看不起太监，
fullTextEN: Because people in the past looked down on eunuchs,

fullTextZH: 就是觉得太监很不好、很没用。
fullTextEN: thinking eunuchs were very bad and useless.

fullTextZH: 其实中国很久很久以前就有太监了。
fullTextEN: Actually, eunuchs have existed in China for a very long time.

fullTextZH: 有些太监让皇帝很喜欢，
fullTextEN: Some eunuchs were liked by the emperor,
making the emperor listen to them,
so they became very wealthy,
very powerful,
and very important.

fullTextZH: 可是大部分的太监很可怜。
fullTextEN: But most eunuchs were very pitiful.
Their work was very hard,
and people would laugh at them,
haha, and hate them,

fullTextZH: 因为他们变得不像男人了。
fullTextEN: because they became unlike men.

fullTextZH: 还好现在中国没有这么可怕的工作了。
fullTextEN: Fortunately, such terrifying jobs no longer exist in China now.

fullTextZH: 孙耀庭是中国的最后一个太监。
fullTextEN: Sun Yaoting was the last eunuch in China.
He passed away in 1996.
After him,
there were no more eunuchs in China.
Okay, this is today's story.
If you like this story,
and want to know more,
you can go and watch

fullTextZH: 《中国的最后一个太监》这个电影。
fullTextEN: the movie 'The Last Eunuch of China'.

fullTextZH: 它是关于孙耀庭的故事。
fullTextEN: It is about the story of Sun Yaoting.

fullTextZH: 你也可以看看《末代皇帝》这个电影。
fullTextEN: You can also watch the movie 'The Last Emperor'.

fullTextZH: 它是关于中国最后一个皇帝
fullTextEN: It is about the last emperor of China,
the story of Puyi.
He was also Sun Yaoting's boss.
Okay, see you next time.
